text: Since 1 Nov 2026, every time an operator note reports gas at a well, did we get someone out to that well in time under our operating procedures? List every report and whether the response met the deadline.
answer:
No, not every report met the deadline; out of 26 reports since 1 Nov 2026, 17 met the deadline and 9 missed it.

*   **Compliance Summary:**
    *   Total reports: 26
    *   Met deadline: 17
    *   Missed deadline: 9
*   **Example Missed Responses:**
    *   **WELL-0163 (Northeast Block 8):** Report [CTX-0163-002] on 2026-11-03; response [MNT-0163-019] took 251.1 hours (limit 24 h).
    *   **WELL-0341 (Northwest Block 12):** Report [CTX-0341-002] on 2026-11-19; response [INS-0341-0109] took 677.8 hours (limit 24 h).
    *   **WELL-0332 (Northwest Block 12):** Report [CTX-0332-004] on 2026-12-03; no response recorded.
    *   **WELL-0401 (Northwest Block 12):** Report [CTX-0401-002] on 2026-12-05; response [MNT-0401-033] took 138.2 hours (limit 24 h).
    *   **WELL-0052 (Southwest Block 24):** Report [CTX-0052-003] on 2026-12-18; no response recorded.
    *   **WELL-0362 (Northwest Block 12):** Report [CTX-0362-002] on 2026-12-24; response [MNT-0362-030] took 31.8 hours (limit 24 h).
    *   **WELL-0161 (Northeast Block 8):** Report [CTX-0161-006] on 2026-12-25; response [INS-0161-0168] took 475.2 hours (limit 24 h).
